name: org_graph_person_get
description: Read one person as the Org Graph holds them: their memberships of live units (unit, role, allocation, since, and the provider that holds each, "espalia" or an HRIS), their employment facts in effect today (title, level, manager, cost centre, site, employment, start date), each with its provider and since when, and their history newest first: each change with the day it took effect, when the Org Graph learned it, its provider and who made it. A membership or fact Espalia holds that nobody has changed or confirmed within the tenant's threshold carries stale: when it was last checked and by whom. A forgotten person reads as "Former member". Admins only while the Org Graph is unfinished.
